w:r.w:t: This document is based on Gold Of Fortunes. Other slot games may have different PS structures and response objects.
All SlotGameServer APIs communicate via MessagePack serialization + AES encryption.
Since this is not standard REST JSON, the client must follow the common packet structure.
All API requests are serialized with MessagePack and sent in the HTTP body.
[Key(0)] public CCProto PID { get; set; } // Protocol ID
[Key(1)] public string API { get; set; } // API path (e.g., "Slot/1/Spin")
[Key(2)] public long MIDX { get; set; } // Member index
[Key(3)] public long SKEY { get; set; } // Session key (received from login response)
[Key(4)] public long SEQ { get; set; } // Sequence number (used only for SeqRequest APIs)
[Key(5)] public string AUTH_TOKEN { get; set; } // Authentication token
[Key(6)] public string Ver { get; set; } // Game client version
[Key(7)] public string Data { get; set; } // AES-encrypted request body (JSON)
[Key(8)] public LangID LID { get; set; } // Language (e.g., ko, en, zh)
[Key(9)] public int SlotID { get; set; } // Slot game ID
All server responses are also serialized with MessagePack.
[Key(0)] public string API { get; set; } // API path
[Key(1)] public byte PACKET_TYPE { get; set; } // Packet type
[Key(2)] public long MEMBER_IDX { get; set; } // Member index
[Key(3)] public long SESSION_KEY { get; set; } // Session key
[Key(4)] public long SEQ { get; set; } // Next sequence number
[Key(5)] public int CODE { get; set; } // Result code (0 = success)
[Key(6)] public string MSG { get; set; } // Result message
[Key(7)] public bool CONT_YN { get; set; } // Whether the game can continue
[Key(8)] public string Data { get; set; } // AES-encrypted response body (JSON)
**The AES-128 fixed key must be provided separately.** Contact the server administrator.
Body: MessagePack serialized binary (Note: actual body format differs from Content-Type)
The following shows which fields of CCRequestCommonPacket are actually used by the server.
The original client was implemented in Unity (C#). For Cocos Creator web build environments, note the following:
**BigInt Handling**: Fields such as `MemberIdx` and `SessionKey` are `long` (64-bit integers). JavaScript `Number` is only accurate up to 53 bits, so `BigInt` or string handling is required.
**MessagePack LZ4 Compression**: The server uses LZ4Block compression. `@msgpack/msgpack` does not natively support LZ4, so server-side compression settings need to be coordinated.
**Retry Logic**: On network timeout, retry up to 3 times with the same SEQ.
**Content-Type**: Set to `application/json` but send the body as MessagePack binary.
Different filters are applied per API.
No session verification. Used before login.
Session verification via Redis. For APIs that don't require ordering.
Session + sequence verification via Redis. For game progression APIs (duplicate prevention).
SeqRequest Duplicate Handling: When re-requesting with the same SEQ, the previous response is returned from cache as-is.
Login using a game link token for production.
| -> Partner system pre-registers user info to our API server (stores token in Redis)
| -> Redirects to game launch URL containing gp parameter
| [STEP 1] Extract gp parameter from URL (Decryption key: f429dc4d624d461d8989409f3a4c1b38)
| -> AES-128 decryption -> JSON parsing -> Obtain { GateUrl, Token }
| -> Receive GameServerUrl from response (actual slot game server address)
| -> Pass GameParam value in Params (value received from Gate response)
| Extract Token from gp -> Look up user info from Redis
| -> LIVE environment: gp token is deleted after single use
URL format that the partner delivers to the game client:
AES-128 encrypted + Base64 URL-safe encoded JSON string. Decrypting reveals the Gate server address and Redis token key.
Decrypting the gp value with NIU_CLIENT_LINK_KEY using AES-128 yields the following JSON:
Gate API server URL (`NiuNiu.ApiWebServer`). Call `GetServiceInfo` on this URL to receive the actual game server address.
Key for user session info stored in Redis. Used for Gate API and login.
Default language. Overridden by the URL's `gl` parameter if present.
**Note**: The `gp` does **not** contain the game server address. Only the Gate server address is included; the actual game server address (`game_svr_url`) is obtained through the Gate API call.
**The AES-128 decryption key (`NIU_CLIENT_LINK_KEY`) must be provided separately.** Contact the server administrator.
After decrypting gp to obtain GateUrl and Token, call the Gate API to receive the actual game server address.
Actual slot game server address. All subsequent APIs (including login) use this URL.

`GameServerUrl` is retrieved from the `game_app.game_svr_url` column in the server Config DB. If a server administrator changes this value, the game server that clients connect to will change accordingly.
Send the login request to the GameServerUrl received from the Gate API. The Params field should contain the GameParam value from the Gate API response, not the original gp from the URL.
"UID": "Internal user ID (GUID format, different from partner UID)",
"Aky": "AES-256 session key for all subsequent requests",

Executes a spin. Betting, spinning, and win payout are all processed in this single API.

Claims accumulated winnings from feature spins (free spins/topup game) and pick games.
Selects an item in the jackpot pick game. Select one of 9 tiles; matching 3 wins the corresponding jackpot.
Selects the next stage during the feature selection phase. In GoldOfFortunes, when 6 or more Trail symbols appear in a normal spin, the player chooses between Topup Game or Free Spins.
Queries the current balance via partner callback.
When the player cannot spin due to insufficient balance, and the partner has added funds (e.g., via deposit), use this API to refresh the balance.

When participating in a cash race, retrieves your rank along with ranks above and below.
Some APIs only work in `__LOCAL__` / `__DEV__` builds.
Response: Same structure as AckLogin + additional fields (CC, BC, SlotCash, etc.)
**Steps 0-1 are performed only once on initial connection.** The same procedure is followed on reconnection.
| +-- Select Topup Game -> TOPUP_SPIN_START -> TOPUP_SPIN (loop) -> TOPUP_SPIN_END
| +-- Select Free Spins -> FREE_SPIN_START -> FREE_SPIN (loop) -> FREE_SPIN_END
**Trail Symbols** (01-06): Appear on normal spin reels and accumulate in the topup game grid (16 slots)
**Topup Game**: 15 link positions + 1 Grand slot. Yellow=collect current Red total, Green=collect all, SpinAdd=extra spins
**Free Spins**: Uses FreeSpinTrail symbols. Trail hits add to total feature winnings
**Pick Game**: Triggered when 3+ Wild symbols accumulate. Match 3 of 9 tiles to determine jackpot
SeqRequest APIs (Enter, Spin, Claim, Pick, SelectFeature) must send the correct sequence number.
**Starting Value**: `Seq` field value from the login response (`AckLogin`)
**Increment Rule**: Use the `SEQ` value from the success response as-is for the next request `SEQ` (the server returns the next SEQ in the response)
**Retransmission**: If a response is not received due to network error, **re-request with the same SEQ** -> the server returns the cached previous response
-> Enter request: SEQ = 1 / Success response: SEQ = 2 -> Next SEQ = 2
-> Spin request: SEQ = 2 / Success response: SEQ = 3 -> Next SEQ = 3
-> Spin retry: SEQ = 3 -> Server returns cached response (SEQ = 4) -> Next SEQ = 4
On SEQ error, error code is returned in CODE -> Re-login required
The next API to call depends on the Res.NextStage value in the spin response.
Key Rule: If NextStage value is 100 (NEED_CLAIM) or above, /Claim must be called.
